# Generated gateway protobuf/gRPC code

**DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.**

This directory is generated from [`proto/playsmith/v1/gateway.proto`](../../../proto/playsmith/v1/gateway.proto)
by `protoc-gen-go` (v1.36.12) and `protoc-gen-go-grpc` (v1.6.2), driven by
`protoc` (v3.21.12).

Regenerate with:

    make proto            # regenerate in place
    make proto-check      # fail if committed code differs from a fresh generation

The `proto-check` target is the forbidden-modification guard: any hand edit to
the files in this directory (or any proto change not regenerated) makes the
build fail, so handwritten interface changes can no longer hide inside the
generated surface.
